newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel down 3.0 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel down 3.0 pct on results.

text.p: Mobile phone operator Telecel lost three percent at the start of trade in Lisbon on investor disappointment that its 1996 results did not match the most optimistic forecasts, traders said.
The shares were being traded at 12,600 escudos shortly after the start, down 401 escudos on the Monday close. Tuesday was a public holiday in Portugal.
The company posted a 1996 net profit of 7.3 billion escudos, up 199 percent on the previous year. Analysts said the most optimistic forecasts had been for profit of eight to nine billion escudos.
Traders said that Telecel had risen sharply in final sessions before the results were announced on hopes that the highest forecasts would be matched.
